themes.name: Industry
themes.note: Default day theme (the design project Suderra Console, 2026-11-23). A technical drawing: steel blue on a light grey ground, a deep steel rail, square hairline-framed plates. The primary is the steel accent one step deeper than the design's #5980a6 (#507395), so its label keeps 4.5:1.

themes.name: Fjord
themes.note: Default day theme. The fjord: deep navy water (the logo navy) under a pale, cold sky; the logo teal as the single accent.

themes.name: Polarnatt
themes.note: Night theme. The polar night: blue-black, with the little light there is kept for text and figures.

themes.name: Nordlys
themes.note: Night theme for the wall screen. The northern lights: an indigo-black sky, one aurora-green accent, a faint green glow at the foot of the rail. Nothing else moves or glows.

themes.name: Tang
themes.note: Day theme. Kelp and sea grass: a deep kelp rail, green-grey canvas, sea-grass accent. For sites that live in green light under the water line.

themes.name: Laks
themes.note: Day theme, warm. Salmon: warm snow canvas, a charcoal rail like a smokehouse wall, salmon flesh as the accent — on the rail only, so it never reads as a critical red.

tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: Page canvas. Frame sheets on it with line-hair.

tokens.name: surface-sheet
tokens.usage: The one sheet per page, dialogs, drawers, cards, tiles. Body text on it is text-1.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table heads, wells, row hover, skeletons. text-1/2/3 all pass on it.

tokens.name: surface-rail
tokens.usage: Left rail and the title bar of a movable window. Text on it is text-on-rail.

tokens.name: text-on-rail
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on surface-rail (10:1 or more in every theme).

tokens.name: line-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines: sheet frame, row rules, dividers. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outlined buttons, gauge tracks, outline chips: 3:1 on every surface incl. sunken.

tokens.name: text-1
tokens.usage: Primary text, figures, codes on sheet, canvas and sunken.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: column heads, why-lines, hold chips.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary: help under fields, sub-lines, origin and age.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The single commit button per view, filled ink.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on primary.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Links, selection, active tab underline, pressed toggles: what you can follow or select.

tokens.name: action-tint
tokens.usage: Selected row, pressed segmented toggle fill; action text stays legible on it.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The theme's one brand accent, on surface-rail only: DERRA in the wordmark, the 3px stripe atop the rail, the active-item bar. Never on data, links or buttons.

tokens.name: focus-inner
tokens.usage: Inner 2px of the double focus ring.

tokens.name: focus-outer
tokens.usage: Outer 2px of the double focus ring. On the rail the ring is focus-inner alone.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: OK mark: a check-circle with no container.

tokens.name: ok-text
tokens.usage: Text on ok-tint.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Rare: a success flash background.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning mark: triangle glyph, 4px row edge, gauge fill past a warning bound (shapes only, 3:1).

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Warning text, on sheet and on warn-tint. Pinned by a test at 4.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Warning chip, ack box and flash fill.

tokens.name: crit
tokens.usage: Critical solid: chip fill with on-crit word, 4px row edge, limit line 2px. Red means critical only.

tokens.name: crit-text
tokens.usage: Critical text on sheet and on crit-tint.

tokens.name: crit-tint
tokens.usage: Critical tint: blocking error box, overdue report chip, toxic zone base.

tokens.name: on-crit
tokens.usage: Word on crit fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and the phone menu sheet.

tokens.name: chart-s1

tokens.name: chart-s2
tokens.usage: Series 2: the ink line, the default single series.

tokens.name: chart-s3
tokens.usage: Series 3.

tokens.name: chart-s4
tokens.usage: Series 4.

tokens.name: chart-s5
tokens.usage: Series 5.

tokens.name: chart-iso

tokens.name: chart-crit

tokens.name: chart-warn
tokens.usage: Chart: a warning zone or line.

tokens.name: chart-ok
tokens.usage: Chart: the safe zone.

tokens.name: chart-note
tokens.usage: Chart: a note marker.

tokens.name: chart-stale

tokens.name: note
tokens.usage: Status: a note, something to know that is not a fault (a withdrawal, a planned job). Its glyph (a square) and edge. No hue on purpose, as the monitoring wall has always drawn it: calm, told by its glyph and word, never by colour.

tokens.usage: Words of a note chip, on note-tint or the sheet.

tokens.name: note-tint

tokens.name: stale
tokens.usage: Status second axis: old or assumed data. NO hue on purpose (an area hue can never be taken for it): the hatch lines and the dashed edge, drawn as a pattern (ui-stale), never a fill colour alone.

tokens.usage: Words of a stale value or its age chip ("9 h old"), on the sheet or stale-tint.

tokens.name: stale-tint
tokens.usage: Ground under the stale hatch.

look.note: A look is the theme-independent shape of the console: radius, type, densities. The classic look is the :root tokens above; a look overrides some of them under its selector, in every theme. next is the design console of 2026-11-23 (Industry design system: square hairline objects, Barlow headings over Atkinson Hyperlegible Next), shown behind ?ui=next (core/ui.py). Sizes in it scale with --k, the density factor the component layer sets per width (static/css/ds.css, Look).
